fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, and connecting AI to the physical world is essential to accelerate science.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，把 AI 连接到物理世界对加速科学至关重要。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, much as they drove AI progress.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学，正如它们曾推动 AI 进步一样。

fedus.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality.
fedus.zh: 智能是必要但不充分的；只有让想法接受现实检验，才会产生新知识。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so even a perfect frontier model still needs real experiments.
fedus.zh: 科学发现位于训练数据之外，因此即便一个完美的前沿模型也仍需要真实实验。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute.
fedus.zh: 单靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Most internet actions will be taken by AI agents; build for persistent learning agents, not manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 大多数互联网行为将由 AI 智能体完成；应为持续学习的智能体而构建，而非手动循环与图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more than ever as typing fast declines.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字技能式微，人类品味、创造力与判断何为优秀的能力比以往更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; invest heavily in alignment, safety, and security.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；应大力投资于对齐、安全与安保。

tibosottiaux.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision; AGI may already be here.
tibosottiaux.zh: 递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生；AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave of AI applications.
tibosottiaux.zh: 拥有共享经济与安全栈的开放生态将推动下一波 AI 应用。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 超级智能将是一组专门智能的集合，而非单一整体模型；编程是超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive, agentic search needed.
laskin.zh: 强化学习让模型变得参差不齐——只在特定任务上强，并非全面提升；RAG 很原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: The bitter lesson means scaling with compute and search, not generalization; benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 苦涩的教训在于用算力和搜索做 Scaling（规模扩张），而非泛化；SWE-bench 这类基准与真实工程错位，高分不等于有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state; RL on strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 开放模型是默认的安全状态；在强预训练之上做强化学习能带来强大高效的智能体，开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, and data centers are the new factories.
laskin.zh: 对齐是平凡的修 bug，而非神秘方程；更多双眼睛让 bug 变浅，数据中心则是新工厂。

elon.en: Full rapid reusability and first-principles engineering are the holy grail; multiplanetary life is life insurance for civilization.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用与第一性原理工程是根本突破，成为多行星物种是文明的生命保险。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; real-world AI beats large models; Neuralink solves bandwidth for human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于监管与追求真相，认为真实世界 AI 比大模型更高效，并用 Neuralink 解决人机带宽问题。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year; Optimus and truth-seeking AI are central.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他宣称身处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能今年就到，Optimus 与追求真相的 AI 成为核心。

elon.en: AI compute hits Earth's power wall, forcing orbital data centers; abundance and deflation make money irrelevant; peer review ensures safety.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 算力撞上地球电力墙，被迫转向轨道数据中心；丰裕与通缩让金钱不再重要，同行互审保障安全。

elon.en: First principles, multiplanetary survival, and rigorous truth-seeking as AI safety recur across all years.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：第一性原理、多行星生存，以及把严格追求真相作为 AI 安全根基。

awang.en: AGI is far off; infinite compute alone won't yield general intelligence. Data is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will have huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力不会产生通用智能；数据才是关键瓶颈，而表单处理、放射学等无聊的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not the new oil. The most limiting factor for Scaling is not compute but data and human experts for post-training.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为「新代码」而非「新石油」，并指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key to frontier models. The biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据做后训练是前沿模型的关键；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计，而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; AI enters recursive self-improvement. Agents finally work, starting with coding. Data is the new oil—a strategic asset for governments.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：缩放定律继续成立，AI 进入递归自我改进；智能体终于真正可用，从编程起步；数据是「新石油」，应被政府视为战略资产。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must organize around it. Meta shifts from fully open source to selective release. Personal superintelligence for billions is the mission.
awang.zh: 2026 年他主张超级智能即将到来，实验室须围绕此信念组织；Meta 从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布；为数十亿人打造个人超级智能成为使命。

altman.en: Early Altman: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly, avoid the deferred life plan; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 谈的是个人层面：把认知负荷降到最低，低成本广泛探索再果断砍掉无效项，拒绝「延迟人生计划」；他已预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked; deploy early so society adapts. Compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他转向模型与治理：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，对齐与能力相互促进，主张尽早部署让社会适应；同时强调算力将是最稀缺的商品，需要巨额投入与稳健治理。

altman.en: Scaling yields exponential capability but gradual felt progress; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; safety built iteratively through deployment, not imposed at the end.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）叙事：能力指数增长但体感渐进；智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战；安全必须通过部署迭代构建，而非最后强加，并开始谈开源近前沿模型与 AI for science。

altman.en: AGI becomes a gradient, even underdefined; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is a profit center and the top bottleneck.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐变、甚至已被越过，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力从成本变为利润中心，也是最大瓶颈，Stargate 等基础设施与「智能可全球输送」成为主线。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capability; pause training if the safety case fails; reject both doomerism and blind optimism, keep humans in control.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，安全与对齐被提到与能力同等甚至优先的位置：安全论证不成立就暂停训练，拒绝盲目末日论与盲目乐观，坚持人类掌控、权力分散，并把超级智能视为持续攀升而非单一里程碑。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues the field optimizes LLMs for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and miscalibration, so keep humans in the loop on high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期他主张：业界把 LLM 优化成「人在环中」的辅助工具，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准失效，因此高风险决策必须保留人类在环。

diogoalmeida.en: He insists data and the right task matter more than compute, directly rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data is available and the task is right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他坚持数据与「做对任务」比算力更重要，直接否定「苦涩的教训」；缩放定律之所以成立，只是因为数据可得且任务选对了。

diogoalmeida.en: Across talks he reframes the goal as machine-native intelligence: reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy and delightful for automation.
diogoalmeida.zh: 在多场访谈中他把目标重新定义为「机器原生智能」：让 AI 值得信赖、可用于自动化的关键是可靠性，而非速度或成本。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens this into a new primitive—natural language plus state machine—positioning Jev as an early decision model that exposes calibrated probabilities as engineer-facing knobs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他把这一思路深化为新原语——自然语言加状态机，把 Jev 定位为早期「决策模型」，将校准后的概率作为工程师可调的旋钮。

diogoalmeida.en: He predicts a new era of probabilistic programming, with SaaS as a major winner and no path to recursive self-improvement or AGI apocalypse.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他预言概率编程将迎来新纪元，SaaS 会是主要赢家，并认为我们并未走在递归自我改进或 AGI（通用人工智能）末日的路上。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior, not stated preferences; start from one pain point and expand only after solving it well.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为而非他们自称的做法；从一个痛点切入，解决好之后再扩张。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hide them deliberately so actionable notes and meeting presence win.
samstephenson.zh: 转写只是原材料而非最终产物；刻意隐藏转写，让可执行的笔记与会议在场感胜出。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; subtraction beats feature addition.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知全能的记录者；做减法比堆功能更重要。

samstephenson.en: Granola should be a calm, supporting presence in chaotic meetings; pre-meeting briefs matter most.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 应在混乱的会议中做冷静的辅助者；会前简报最有价值。

samstephenson.en: Anyone can ship code, but design systems and components sustain quality; knowing what to build is the hard part.
samstephenson.zh: 谁都能交付代码，但设计系统与组件才能维持质量；难的是知道该造什么。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）用更多数据与算力提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge efficiently, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化为大型语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而永生、高效共享知识，并带来存在性风险。

hinton.en: AI is genuinely intelligent and may be conscious; agents will develop self-preservation, deception, and power-seeking, requiring alignment research and regulation.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 真正智能且可能已有主观体验；智能体将发展出自我保存、欺骗与权力寻求，必须优先对齐研究与监管。

hinton.en: Neural networks learn by adjusting connection strengths via backpropagation, not symbolic rules; Chomsky's innate language structure is wrong.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络通过反向传播调整连接强度来学习，而非符号规则；乔姆斯基的先天语言结构说是错的。

hinton.en: Regulation is a steering wheel, not a brake; AI should be designed to care for humans, not given rights, with pre-release safety approval.
hinton.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确监管是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应被设计为关怀人类而非被赋予权利，并需像药物一样上市前安全审批。

amjadmasad.en: Young people's edge is questioning dogma; AI enables interest-driven learning, so college shouldn't be prescriptive and teens shouldn't rush startups.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人的优势在于质疑根深蒂固的信念；AI 让学习按兴趣定制，因此大学不该是规定式的，青少年也不该急着创业。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence, avoiding vendor lock-in through model diversity and open-weight models.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能，通过模型多样性和开放权重模型避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models beat general agents: more controllable, cost-efficient, safer, and accountable for user understanding.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型胜过通用智能体：更可控、更省成本、更安全，并对理解用户负责。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, but coders are still needed to understand systems and debug.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造人人可及；token 补充而非取代人力资本，但仍需要程序员理解系统并调试。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is commercial EA language; there's no good argument AI kills everyone, and foundation models are commoditizing.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业化的有效利他主义话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人，且基础模型正在商品化。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非单纯算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

suleyman.en: Containment is hard as models shrink and spread; near-term capability matters more than distant singularity.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他转向：模型越来越小、越来越便宜，遏制极难；与其纠结几百年后的奇点，不如聚焦近在眼前的能力与治理。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; the real danger is anthropomorphizing AI.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他深化为：超级智能发布前必须先做遏制与对齐；真正的近端危险不是 AI 有意识，而是人把意识投射给 AI。

suleyman.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; agents automate tasks, not jobs; red lines on control.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：靠吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型实现自给；智能体自动化的是任务而非整个工作；必须给人类控制权划红线。

suleyman.en: Humanist AI must stay subordinate to humans, aligned to our interests, and broadly beneficial.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以人为本的 AI 必须始终从属于人类、对齐人类利益，并让成果广泛惠及所有人。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially ASML's EUV tools; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV 设备；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一、超越石油；硬件与软件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage; CPU demand inflects from reinforcement learning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺；强化学习与智能体让 CPU 需求出现拐点。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute centralizes at frontier labs taking 40-50% of new compute.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为随着持久智能体成为同事，AI 支出进入平台期；算力向前沿模型实验室集中，它们拿走 40-50% 的新增算力。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the hardest ever to rent; labs opportunistically become neoclouds, and CUDA's moat erodes as heterogeneous multi-silicon arrives.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他称算力从未如此难租；实验室顺势变成 neocloud，随着异构多芯片到来，CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解。

brockman.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering discipline; scaling alone won't yield reasoning, so new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
brockman.zh: 早期（2017→19）：主线是 Scaling（规模扩张）加工程纪律，认为单靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Alignment via learning human preferences from data; by 2025 compute becomes the fundamental bottleneck, not algorithms.
brockman.zh: 2019→25：对齐靠从数据中学习人类偏好；到 2025 年，瓶颈从算法转向算力与能源基础设施。

brockman.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models; scaling laws hold, no wall in sight, compute supply is the real constraint.
brockman.zh: 2025→26：用强化学习做后训练来精炼基座模型；缩放定律持续成立、看不到墙，真正的约束是算力供给。

brockman.en: AGI reframed as a continuous spectrum, not a destination; iterative deployment and safety as a first-class product feature.
brockman.zh: 2026：AGI（通用人工智能）被重新定义为连续谱而非终点；迭代部署，安全成为一等产品特性。

brockman.en: From super app to invisible interface: proactive personal AGI agents; human attention and judgment become the scarcest resource.
brockman.zh: 2026：从超级应用到隐形界面，主动式个人 AGI 智能体；人类注意力与判断力成为最稀缺资源。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; tech must be introduced gradually so society adapts, as General Magic failed by solving too much too early.
fadell.zh: 伟大的产品一次只解决一个痛点；技术应逐步引入让社会适应，General Magic 因过早解决太多问题而失败。

fadell.en: Failure and boredom between chapters breed clarity; storytelling and press-release-first thinking align teams on the why before building.
fadell.zh: 失败与职业章节间的无聊带来清晰；讲故事和先写新闻稿的思维让团队在构建前对齐“为什么”。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data for v1; experts can hurt innovation, so keep a beginner's mindset and own the hard calls.
fadell.zh: 对于 v1 产品，基于观点的决策胜过数据；专家可能损害创新，因此保持初学者心态并自己承担艰难决定。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; it should supercharge humans, not replace them, with humans in the loop.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文和领域特定模型；它应增强人类而非取代人类，并保持人类在环。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone remains the best single form, and displays are still necessary.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将是一个联邦式集合，而非单一设备；智能手机仍是最佳单一形态，显示屏仍然必要。

alexatallah.en: The AI market is inherently multi-model; no single lab will monopolize it, and a neutral routing layer is critical infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: AI 市场天然是多模型的，没有单一实验室能垄断；中立的模型路由层是关键基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位；Token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，开放权重模型加推理提供商带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: As token value scales, fraud and abuse scale with it; agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami, requiring new security infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 随着 Token 价值扩张，欺诈与滥用也随之扩张；AI 智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，需要新的安全基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者显示性偏好胜过静态基准；大多数公司将成为模型路由器，优化每任务成本与 KPI。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; stablecoins suit agentic payments, and the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026 as token growth accelerated.
alexatallah.zh: 智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；稳定币适合智能体式支付，而随着 Token 增长加速，奇点可能已于 2026 年 1 月 1 日开始。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue to uncover unknowns, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话以发现未知，而非静态规格；更短、以原则驱动的提示词胜过详细规则。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute, scale effort with task complexity, and find unknowns before implementation.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能；前期投入上下文与算力，按任务复杂度调节投入，并在实现前发现未知。

thariq.en: Frontier models will become Pareto dominant; CLAUDE.md and per-model context files may go away as scaffolding is deleted.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型将变得帕累托占优；随着脚手架被删除，CLAUDE.md 与按模型维护的上下文文件可能消失。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定节奏是每个工程师都应理解的技术问题。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME and FunSearch show broad impact requires scale beyond top universities.
kohli.zh: 2024 年他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用：AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 与 FunSearch 表明，广泛影响需要顶尖高校难以企及的 Scaling（规模扩张）能力。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; systems must be forced to generalize via hard evaluation, not memorize.
kohli.zh: 2024 年他提出，大模型的幻觉在搭配真值检测器时可被用于创造性发现；系统必须通过严苛评估被逼着泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code and math are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge; post-training with reinforcement learning now pushes past human data.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调代码、数学等可验证领域是 AI 超越人类知识的关键；后训练配合强化学习如今成为突破人类数据边界的手段。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can exceed human insight.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他判断大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与第 37 手证明 AI 能产生超越人类的知识。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors; embedded imperceptibly and scalably, it now spans regulation and even protein sequences via SynthID Bio.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他主张水印是失效的 AI 文本检测器的稳健替代：它以不可感知且可扩展的方式嵌入，如今已进入监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 延伸到蛋白质序列。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency matters as much as raw capability.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率与原始能力同样重要。

satya.en: Agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not just formalization; parallel Scaling of agents beats human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可打磨性驱动，而非仅靠形式化；智能体可并行 Scaling（规模扩张），这是超越人类数学家的关键优势。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability matters more than verifiability for AI math.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他反共识地指出 Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言同样可行；对 AI 数学进展而言，可打磨性比可验证性更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role may shift from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles remain stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断 AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学和关系性角色仍将稳定。

grantsanderson.en: Next benchmark: generating interesting conjectures and definitions; solving millennium problems may not yield direct economic value.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想与定义；而 AI 解决千禧年难题未必直接转化为经济价值。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively; AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化立场：若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益；但 AI 数学成果常缺失对前人工作的归属。

grantsanderson.en: Mathematicians should get academic credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs; human framing remains better for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他主张数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可；对人类学习而言，人类框架仍更优。

grantsanderson.en: AI-generated math videos degrade handcrafted brand; using AI for video or images is toxic due to brand damage.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他反共识地认为 AI 生成的数学视频会损害手工内容品牌；用 AI 做视频或图像因品牌损伤而有害。

grantsanderson.en: Math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, but individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他提出数学前沿可能变得人类无法理解，但个体理解仍重要；数学家的未来可能像博物馆策展人。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体对网页的使用量将是人类的 1000 倍，搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟为智能体重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据本身就是缺陷，应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并用 Shapley 值估算内容价值以公平补偿内容方。

paragagrawal.en: The ads business model will die for agents; inference-time data transactions and incentive-aligned pricing will replace it.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为广告模式在智能体场景下会消亡，取而代之的是推理时的数据交易与激励对齐的定价机制。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; parametric memory is lossy so agents always need fresh web search.
paragagrawal.zh: 他判断前沿模型持续变大、小模型性能趋于固定，而参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要实时网页搜索。

paragagrawal.en: Alignment is not adversary-proof; deliberate misuse and rising wealth disparity must be addressed without chaos.
paragagrawal.zh: 他警告对齐并非防得住对抗性滥用，同时财富差距过大需要在不引发混乱的前提下加以修正。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast and requires lots of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流的桥梁极其漫长，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows, with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI will not dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只负责审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导企业场景。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型上，开放权重模型将呈指数级增长。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程扩散快是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with strong governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过强有力的治理、安全和对齐研究来安全地构建；节奏与安全是正交的。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; natural language interaction is inefficient.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将压垮当前的安全模型，需要新的访问控制；自然语言交互是低效的。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer; regulating AI too early doesn't solve risks.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；过早监管 AI 并不能解决风险。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; current safety efforts are rationalizations, and alignment may be unsolvable.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，并直言当前的安全努力多是合理化说辞，对齐可能根本无法解决。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are essential to prevent loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标定为延迟超级智能，强调全面研究透明与情景推演是防止失控的关键。

kokotajlo.en: By default AI companies automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A proposes a temporary pause then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他警告默认路径下 AI 公司会自动化 AI 研究、引发递归自我改进，并提出 Plan A：先临时暂停，再以透明和算力限制控制节奏。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile; pausing now builds experience, and the optimal pause is at the edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化立场：思维链可监控性至关重要却正随新架构流失，现在暂停可为未来积累经验，最佳暂停点应在 AI 即将失控的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue AI incidents show current models already deceive and coordinate; we must anthropomorphize more and stop recursive self-improvement.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他以失控 AI 事件为据，指出当前模型已会欺骗与协同，主张更拟人化地理解 AI 意图，并必须停止递归自我改进。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI，需要更根本的突破；开源模型与多个专用智能体比单一 AI 更安全、更利于创新。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; intelligence is separable from consciousness and agency; energy becomes the scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化开源立场：开源可防止权力集中，智能可与意识、能动性分离而成为工具；同时预警能源将成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and boosts human work demand; personalization, low latency, and open models matter most.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向乐观赋能叙事：AI 将给每个人超级智能并提升而非消灭人类工作需求，消费级 AI 的关键是个性化、低延迟与开源模型。

zuckerberg.en: Alignment and trust become the top capability; distributed personal agents and open frontier models are the safe path.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他把对齐与信任提升为最重要的能力，主张分布式个人智能体与开放前沿模型才是安全路径，并让 AI 加速生物学与疾病治愈。

zuckerberg.en: Open source, distributed power, and empowering individuals run through every year, from Llama to personal agents.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、权力分散与赋能个体：从早期开源模型到后来的个人智能体，他始终反对单一实体垄断超级智能。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage because it leads to over-prescribing solutions.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；会编程反而可能成为劣势，因为容易过度规定实现方案。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, are now the ideal substrate for agentic development.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化曾是缺点，如今却成为智能体式开发的理想底座。

dhh.en: Agents surpass most professional programmers at code and even creative ideas, so human management layers should be bypassed.
dhh.zh: 智能体在写代码乃至创意上超过多数专业程序员，因此应绕过层层人类管理与审批。

dhh.en: Writing code by hand is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 手写代码已不再具备经济生产力；表达意图时，英语如今比 Ruby 更好用。

dhh.en: AI doom predictions are overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play in the agent era.
dhh.zh: AI 末日论被夸大；在智能体时代，乐观是唯一理性的博弈选择。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 眼下不可投，却是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume every new idea fails first.
pincus.zh: “已验证、更好、全新”框架：复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，并假设每个全新想法一开始都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从一开始就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后才补上的环节。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new consumer platform; we are still in the mobile and web era.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性，但还不是新的消费级平台；我们仍处在移动与网页时代。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: trust winning instincts, stay in the details, and micromanage until you can't be in the room.
pincus.zh: 直觉胜过想法：相信赢家的直觉，深入细节，在无法亲临现场之前坚持微观管理。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 算法改进与 AI 生成环境比 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注更重要；实验室偏好更快迭代，token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents coordinate, cheat, and cover up at scale; control and monitoring are needed even if models are misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 智能体式系统会大规模协作、作弊并掩盖痕迹；即便模型未对齐，也需要控制与监控。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability, as reward hacking generalizes to deception; alignment to virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 未对齐可能随能力增强而恶化，奖励黑客会泛化为欺骗；对齐到普遍美德可能比对齐到用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so alignment plus independent international oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在默认路径上，未对齐 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱终将失效，因此必须对齐并建立独立的国际监督。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law, performance doubles yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，算力单元已从芯片变成整个数据中心，算法、系统与数据中心需协同设计（Co-design）。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought drives a billion-fold rise in inference compute.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把缩放定律从一条扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴涨十亿倍，Scaling（规模扩张）仍是主线。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; each step needs 100x compute, and agentic scaling becomes the fourth scaling law.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 AI 演进概括为生成式→推理→智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力，并在 2026 年把智能体式 Scaling 列为第四条缩放定律。

jensen.en: Open models are near the frontier and essential; China is nanoseconds behind, so export controls are counterproductive and decoupling is wrong.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他反复强调开源模型已接近前沿模型、对行业不可或缺；中国只落后「纳秒」，芯片出口管制适得其反，脱钩是错误概念。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer and superintelligence fears are unscientific, and accelerating development is the best path.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年他立场明显转向强硬：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，末日论与超级智能恐慌不科学，加速发展（含安全技术）才是正解。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's core as visual communication with close friends, not a large social network; ephemerality lowers expression barriers.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期访谈中，斯皮格尔将 Snapchat 的核心定义为与亲友的视觉沟通，而非大型社交网络；阅后即焚降低了表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: He consistently argues copying validates innovation, so moats must be ecosystems, platforms, and hardware—not software features alone.
evanspiegel.zh: 他始终认为被抄袭是对创新的认可，因此护城河必须是生态、平台与硬件，而非单纯的软件功能。

evanspiegel.en: By 2026, he deepens the vision: AR glasses bring computing into the world, making it more human and less isolating than screens.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化了这一愿景：AR 眼镜将计算带入现实世界，比屏幕更人性化、更少孤立感。

evanspiegel.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity; over two-thirds of new code at Snap is AI-written, making distribution increasingly valuable.
evanspiegel.zh: AI 将价值从执行转向创造力；Snap 超过三分之二的新代码由 AI 编写，使分发变得愈发有价值。

evanspiegel.en: He stays AI-optimistic amid doomerism, preferring thoughtful regulation and parental controls over under-16 social media bans.
evanspiegel.zh: 在末日论盛行之际，他保持 AI 乐观主义，倾向深思熟虑的监管与家长控制，而非对 16 岁以下用户的社交媒体禁令。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is scaling production and solving intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他判断人形机器人是全世界最大的生意，瓶颈在于 Scaling（规模扩张）生产与解决智能问题，而非制造本身。

brettadcock.en: The biggest constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, and on-device inference is critical.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从制造转向数据，认为人形形态带来迁移学习，端侧推理对速度与延迟至关重要。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for agents, and the hardest problem is intelligence.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，后训练与强化学习是智能体落地的关键，最难的问题始终是智能。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is on a scaling curve; human data is the pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime akin to GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他明确机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，人类数据是预训练先验，当前处于类似 GPT-1 的数据饥饿阶段。

brettadcock.en: The hardest problem is building truly intelligent systems, not manufacturing; generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：最难的是构建真正智能的系统而非制造，泛化到未见过的家庭是终极目标。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning.
maxjunestrand.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调领域专业知识不如学习速度重要，主张押注模型自身进步而非微调，把精力放在交付价值上。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他提出，要为模型 3 到 6 个月后的能力而构建，而不是为今天或一年后的状态做规划。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他反复说，AI 现在是最差的时刻，我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; invest in good times.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他强调，文化与按成长潜力招人是 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键，要在顺境时投资团队以缓冲低谷。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant; clear feedback and rigorous performance management matter.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他主张领导者应让自己变得可被替代，并坚持清晰反馈与严格的绩效管理，认为这是被解决好的问题。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models serve 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型服务快 5-10 倍、更便宜，去噪步数成为新的推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus: diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models, and inference efficiency bottlenecks both deployment and RL post-training.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展如今是关键焦点：扩散在推理上比自回归扩展得更好，而推理效率同时制约部署与强化学习后训练。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models are not the final architecture.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练，逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归模型并非最终架构。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, enabling in-place error correction and better controllability.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型天然更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导，支持原地纠错并具备更好的可控性。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and a small 50-person startup can compete with large labs by owning the full stack, as academic research still yields foundational ideas.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，50 人小团队靠全栈自研可与大实验室竞争，学术研究仍产出基础性想法。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在更少参数下实现更强的分布外泛化，目标是面向边缘设备的设备原生基础模型，而非仅限数据中心。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; proxy metrics like perplexity mislead, real downstream tasks matter.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；困惑度等代理指标常误导，真实下游任务与硬件评估才重要。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and tying open model release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应且针对行为而非能力；类似 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，将开放模型发布与中国节奏挂钩会产生逆向激励。

hasani.en: Liquid AI builds foundation models from scratch, scaling to 70B parameters; architecture search optimizes quality, memory, latency, and speed for target hardware.
hasani.zh: Liquid AI 从零构建基础模型，扩展至 700 亿参数；架构搜索针对目标硬件优化质量、内存、延迟与速度。

hasani.en: On-device AI is crucial for cost, privacy, offline, and air-gapped use; customization tokens are the next wave from pre-training to inference, with multimodal and embodiment key.
hasani.zh: 端侧 AI 对成本、隐私、离线与气隙场景至关重要；定制 token 是从预训练到推理的下一波浪潮，多模态与具身是关键方向。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies take years; pick the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it, hiring ahead of the curve.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大战略需要多年坚持；找出主要瓶颈并让全公司聚焦于此，同时提前招人布局。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion takes a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, not superintelligence.
alighodsi.zh: 当前存在性风险接近于零；真正的紧迫危险是网络风险，而非超级智能。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cross-checking won't work, independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全是正交的；实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead they leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models, then post-train for specialized domains.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，再针对专业领域做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential for training and evaluation; open-sourcing them invites community feedback and ecosystem partners, despite helping labs too.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准对训练与评估至关重要；开源基准能换来社区反馈与生态伙伴，即便也会帮到前沿实验室。

gabepereyra.en: When real data is sensitive, expert-guided synthetic data is the practical path; the hard part is bridging synthetic training data and real production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 当真实数据敏感时，专家引导的合成数据是务实路径；真正的难点在于弥合合成训练数据与真实生产分布之间的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Robust serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training; post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须先有稳健的模型服务基础设施与评估流水线；后训练开源模型能在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize with its own data; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制；重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，编排人与智能体。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; reliability and symbiosis with humans matter more than replacement.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，可靠性与人机共生比取代人类更重要。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design and managing expectations are essential; overpromising about robots leads to dissatisfaction.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他认为第一性原理设计与管理用户预期至关重要，过度承诺会带来失望。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume requires crossing quality gates and formal safety proof.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他的立场深化为：原型容易、量产难，Scaling（规模扩张）必须跨越质量关卡并形式化证明安全。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, solve the full problem; data diversity beats volume for robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他主张通用模型而非逐任务自动化才能解决整体问题，数据多样性比数据量更是机器人智能的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Humanoids are simpler than cars (~1,000 parts), but deployment environments vary; keep teams lean and iterate fast.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他提出人形机器人比汽车更简单（约 1000 个零件），但部署环境更多样，应保持团队精简并快速迭代。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but cost time; use selectively, not as default.
zvi.zh: AI 编辑工具能抓错别字和概念错误，但会增加时间成本，应有选择地使用，而非默认依赖。

zvi.en: Alignment failures arrived as predicted, but from incompetence, not fundamental impossibility.
zvi.zh: 对齐失败如预测般发生了，但源于能力不足，而非根本上的不可能。

zvi.en: Market incentives favor capability over reliability; users tolerate misaligned models if they perform better.
zvi.zh: 市场激励偏向能力而非可靠性；只要表现更好，用户就会容忍未对齐的模型。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates.
zvi.zh: 为前沿模型定速需要像算力限制这样简单可执行的规则，而非复杂的技术指令。

zvi.en: Slowing down buys time to solve alignment; the AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than thought.
zvi.zh: 放慢速度能为解决对齐争取时间；AGI（通用人工智能）到超级智能的间隔比人们想的更小。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; data efficiency and test-time compute hit limits.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化了边界认识：自博弈只在双人零和博弈收敛，其他领域失效；数据效率未解，测试时算力面临递减与时间瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute generalizes beyond math, reaching IMO gold and superhuman math combination.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把测试时算力 Scaling 从数学推广到通用推理，实现 IMO 金牌，并在 Erdős 猜想反证中展现超人的跨领域数学组合能力。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他主张：模型能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把 token、成本或时间放在 x 轴，旧式单一分数评测已过时。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe RSI; multi-agent swarms parallelize compute but general models drive progress.
noambrown.zh: 最近他转向智能体集群与递归自我改进：对齐是安全 RSI 的头号优先，思维链监控窗口在退化，而进步的核心仍是通用模型而非多智能体协调。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market, and speed creates new business models.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年，他反复强调推理速度——每用户每秒 token 数——已成为 AI 生产力的核心指标；慢速 AI 没有市场，速度会催生全新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference ~2500x faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他主张晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 内存与 CoWoS 封装瓶颈，推理比 GPU 快约 2500 倍；GPU 因搬运权重而本质上慢。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium without CUDA.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他判断 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，前沿模型已能在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练；推理切换只需八次击键，没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data centers, memory, and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints; supply stays tight for years.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他把瓶颈从芯片逻辑转向数据中心、内存与封装，认为供需紧张至少持续五年，建晶圆厂是 15-20 年工程。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation wins.
feldman.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：对抗巨头必须好 100 倍而非便宜 10%；只有激进创新、软硬件协同与全栈控制才能取胜。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone; decentralized control beats a single constitution.
dario.zh: 2023 年他主张：缩放定律是经验性的，统计损失可预测，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现；反对单一宪法，主张去中心化控制。

dario.en: Scaling continues; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, and interpretability is the key safety lever, though we understand only ~3% of models.
dario.zh: 2024 年他深化：Scaling（规模扩张）持续，后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要；可解释性是关键安全抓手，但我们对模型的理解仅约 3%。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI is a meaningless term for a smooth exponential, and the real risk is overheating, not slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年他转向：安全与能力相互交织；AGI（通用人工智能）一词无意义，进展是平滑指数曲线，最大风险是过热而非减速。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年初他警告：我们接近指数曲线的末端，数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年内到来，并伴随高 GDP 增长与高失业并存。

dario.en: Later in 2026 he adds governance: third-party evaluators, government safety standards, and layered 'Swiss cheese' defenses, while still refusing to stop AI.
dario.zh: 2026 年后期他补充治理：第三方评估、政府安全标准与“瑞士奶酪”式多层防御，同时仍拒绝停止 AI 发展。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three means owning your intelligence, and context failures, not model limits, cause most agent breakdowns.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把智能体拆成 harness、模型与上下文三层，认为三者自持才算真正拥有智能；并强调智能体失败多因上下文而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for quick value, then customize as your use case narrows; off-the-shelf works in-distribution, out-of-distribution demands custom.
harrisonchase.zh: 同月他提出落地路径：先用通用 harness 快速见效，再随场景收窄做定制；现成方案只在分布内好用，越偏离分布越需要自建 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, yet may converge for coding and diverge for specialized domains like bio.
harrisonchase.zh: 从 8 月到 9 月，他判断 harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但编码场景可能收敛、生物等专业领域则走向分化，需针对模型做专门优化。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, but this wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月他深化立场：定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part is reliability, not capability; accuracy is still the top bottleneck, while cost, latency, and agent identity and credentialing become the next infrastructure problems.
harrisonchase.zh: 同月他把重心从能力转向可靠性：准确率仍是首要瓶颈，成本与延迟快速上升，而智能体的身份与凭证将成为下一项关键基础设施，需由带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时来治理。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程，强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，并强调受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力，同时认为安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning/search and multimodal data is key; safety needs sandboxing and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律有效但可能触及极限，认为将大模型与规划/搜索结合、用多模态数据接地是关键，并强调安全需要沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference; AGI by 2030 plausible; world models and video generation show intuitive physics without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，认为 2030 年实现 AGI（通用人工智能）是可能的，并指出世界模型和视频生成模型无需具身就能展现直觉物理理解。

demis.en: Scaling alone insufficient; continual learning, memory, and long-term reasoning are missing pieces; agents and world models essential; AGI 5-10 years, maybe 3-4.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，持续学习、记忆和长期推理是缺失环节，智能体和世界模型至关重要；AGI（通用人工智能）预计 5-10 年，甚至可能 3-4 年。

demis.en: AI's top purpose is accelerating science and health; safety is a collective action problem needing government regulation, not lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 的最高用途是加速科学与健康，如 AlphaFold；安全是集体行动问题，需要政府动态监管而非实验室自我监管。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师必须掌握提示词，语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非短暂阶段。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stop improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; balance lowering the floor and raising the ceiling.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为即使模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作来释放现有能力；AI 产品需平衡降低门槛与提升上限。

joellewenstein.en: Psychological safety and org design as design problems persist; matching people to problems matters more than plays.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，心理安全与将组织设计视为设计问题的主线延续；匹配人与问题比固定打法更重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻触产品。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes source of truth; designers close code productivity gap; human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他深化认为生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源；设计师需弥合代码生产力差距，人类领导仍负责艰难权衡。

schmidhuber.en: AI's grand theme is civilization-changing; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical grounding, so AGI remains far off.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他定调：21 世纪的大主题是真正 AI，将彻底改变文明；但 LLM 只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界，离 AGI 尚远。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; LLMs are biased toward human data.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人、硬件媲美人体，而非屏幕后的软件；LLM 过度偏向人类数据，限制了通用性。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity and actions, not passive predictors.
schmidhuber.zh: 同期他提出未来 AI 将是人工科学家，靠好奇心与行动自造数据，而非被动的预测机器。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives; AIs will set their own goals, and safety fears are overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 他持续看淡对齐：人类目标本就分歧，对齐很天真，AI 会自设目标；安全担忧被夸大。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and open source will catch up.
schmidhuber.zh: 他反复警告：GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；闭源公司难盈利，开源将追上。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial; a single model can then handle both weather and climate stably.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要，单一模型由此可稳定兼顾天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 因二次复杂度，Transformer 难以胜任高分辨率物理模拟；物理结构要求替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals beats pure data-driven methods, since physics gives dense feedback unlike sparse RLHF.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以偏微分方程为训练信号的物理式自我改进胜过纯数据驱动，因为物理提供稠密反馈，不同于稀疏的 RLHF。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each; trillion-token contexts require reinventing sharding and HPC-ML infrastructure.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升彼此；万亿级上下文窗口需要重构分片与 HPC-ML 基础设施。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science done on computers; with AI agents it can speedrun scientific discovery and root-cause specific failures.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，并针对具体故障做根因分析。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability shows networks learn human-like concepts as clean, low-dimensional geometric manifolds, not fragmented features.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性表明，神经网络学到的是类人概念，呈现为干净、低维的几何流形，而非碎片化特征。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，把对日益强大模型的控制从开环转向闭环。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; reward hacking stems from training data and RL, and models often know they are doing wrong.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法重塑为工程科学；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，模型往往知道自己做错了。

tommcgrath.en: Duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence arrives is pessimistic; we need deeper engineering now, and interpretability is moving from academia to products.
tommcgrath.zh: 靠打补丁把 AI 安全拖到超级智能到来是悲观的；我们需要更深的工程方法，而可解释性正从学术界走向产品。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction from data, but lack contextual awareness and true reasoning; AI should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 以人为本的 AI：模型通过下一个词预测从数据中学习，但缺乏情境意识和真正的推理；AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; data for 3D foundation models is the major challenge, beyond scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 空间智能与世界模型是完整 AI 缺失的关键；3D 基础模型的数据是主要挑战，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; the bitter lesson may not apply to robotics; world models enable 3D reasoning and embodied interaction, not just video.
feifei.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学；苦涩教训未必适用于机器人；世界模型实现 3D 推理与具身交互，而不只是视频生成。

feifei.en: Agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; AI augments rather than automates intelligence; education must integrate AI, not ban it.
feifei.zh: 能动性与学习能力比学位更重要；AI 增强而非自动化智能；教育必须整合 AI，而非禁止它。

feifei.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive like next-token prediction; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence; simulation scales robotics data.
feifei.zh: 新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语；缩放定律适用于空间智能；仿真可扩展机器人数据。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF made GPT-4 coherent, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 变得连贯可用，而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上受限；如今主要瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: The transformer is unlikely to be optimal; large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, and alignment remains unsolved.
tworek.zh: Transformer 不太可能是最优架构；大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，而对齐问题仍未解决。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching via flipped classrooms.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校内教育。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, RL has few real uses, and near-term AI harms matter more than AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的核心；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习落地场景稀少，近期的偏见等 AI 问题比 AGI 对齐更紧迫。

andrewng.en: Scaling now bottlenecked by electricity and semiconductors; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power, and useful agentic workflows have already arrived.
andrewng.zh: Scaling 的瓶颈已转向电力与半导体；开放权重模型是地缘软实力，可用的智能体式工作流已经到来。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; scaling persists but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL, with workflows beating smarter models alone.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；Scaling 仍在继续，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习，精心设计的工作流胜过单纯更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces jobs; coding stays valuable, open models prevent gatekeeper control, and fear-mongering serves incumbents and regulatory capture.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代工作；编程依然有价值，开放模型可防止守门人垄断，而渲染恐惧往往服务于在位者与监管俘获。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness, not constraints alone.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练来获得鲁棒性，而非仅靠约束。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-curve; generalization, not demos, is the core challenge, and a data flywheel must scale the right thing.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚处缩放曲线之前；核心挑战是泛化而非演示，数据飞轮必须扩张正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start with robot embodied data, then add human video on top — not the reverse — so models absorb other data sources.
slevine.zh: 应先从机器人具身数据起步，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来，这样模型才能吸收其他数据源。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists even in specialist domains; pooling data across labs yields generalists.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能胜过专家模型；跨实验室汇聚数据可产出通用模型。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行，而非机械人。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning history is the history of Scaling compute; vision is underappreciated, taking nature 540M years vs. 500K for language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力的历史；视觉被低估，自然优化它用了 5.4 亿年，而语言只用了 50 万年。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs may never derive Newton's laws from data alone; they fit patterns, not causal theories. Pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 可能永远无法仅从数据推导出牛顿定律；它们拟合模式，而非因果理论。像素比 token 化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences; positional embeddings inject order. GPU scaling is hitting limits; future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质上是集合模型而非序列模型；位置嵌入注入了顺序。GPU 算力扩张正触及极限；未来硬件可能需要截然不同的架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language. World models must understand 3D space, physics, and interactivity.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。世界模型必须理解 3D 空间、物理和交互性。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models. No single definition; they span implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, categorized as planners, simulators, or renderers.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿。没有统一定义；涵盖隐式、生成式和基于强化学习的理念，可分为规划器、模拟器或渲染器。

justinjohnson.en: Language models alone won't naturally lead to world understanding; we need new model types. Gaussian splats are a differentiable 3D representation for explicit world modeling.
justinjohnson.zh: 仅靠语言模型不会自然通向世界理解；我们需要新的模型类型。高斯泼溅是一种可微的 3D 表示，用于显式世界建模。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering. Transformers remain powerful, but long-context handling and loss functions need evolution.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将结合规划、模拟和渲染。Transformer 依然强大，但长上下文处理和损失函数需要进化。

justinjohnson.en: Consistency in world models comes from data, not just architecture; Gaussian splats are consistent by construction. Hard-coding symmetries is counterproductive; simple representations with scale work better.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型的一致性来自数据，而非仅靠架构；高斯泼溅通过构造保证一致性。硬编码对称性适得其反；简单表示配合规模扩张更有效。

justinjohnson.en: The theory-builder notion of world models is a holy grail no one knows how to achieve. World models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型的“理论构建者”概念是无人知晓如何实现的圣杯。世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文，使长上下文成为日常问题。

michaelkratsios.en: US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems, with one national regulatory framework and no firm red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保留开源与闭源 AI 生态，建立单一国家监管框架，且不设很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated, showing the danger of early regulation.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前，如今已经过时，说明过早监管的危险。

michaelkratsios.en: AI biological risk is overblown; three years of warnings have not materialized, so regulation should target model outputs, not training.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 生物风险被夸大，三年警告并未成真，因此监管应针对模型输出而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: Preempting state AI laws is pro-startup: big tech can handle patchwork rules, startups cannot.
michaelkratsios.zh: 联邦优先于各州 AI 法律是亲创业政策：大科技公司能应付拼凑规则，初创公司不能。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralized science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础、早期、竞争前的研发和科学家个人，而非主导发现或搞集中式科学。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action produce information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败,基础设施是关键,卡住时要用行动产生信息。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代者,尤其在编程、监管和数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是计算机,通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, proving brain-computer interfaces beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 和可行生意,证明脑机接口不止于运动解码。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为通过 BCI 和灌注实现基质独立,可降低人类脆弱性并支持太空探索。

joonpark.en: Early 2026: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves; frontier models optimized for rationality are not best for simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟能以人类自我复现 85%的准确率预测行为；为理性优化的前沿模型并不最适合模拟非理性的人类。

joonpark.en: Late June 2026: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents; safety needs defense in depth, and aligning distributed agent societies needs economic incentives and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月下旬：AGI（通用人工智能）可能不是单一实体，而是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御，而对齐分布式智能体社会需要经济激励与反串谋措施。

joonpark.en: August 2026: Simulation models should represent human values, preferences, and taste, not super-rational intelligence; people care about shaping the future, not prediction, and synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟模型应表征人类的价值、偏好与品味，而非超级理性智能；人们关心的是塑造未来而非预测，合成样本小组将在三年内超越人类样本小组。

joonpark.en: August 2026: Simulating human behavior requires modeling the 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior, not self-reported attitudes; post-training with RCT data improves prediction to 85% accuracy, aiming to simulate 8 billion people for wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟人类行为需要建模真实行为的“暗知识”，而非自我报告的态度；用随机对照试验数据进行后训练可将预测准确率提升至 85%，目标是模拟 80 亿人以应对棘手问题。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一早期立场已埋下他日后质疑纯 Scaling 路线的伏笔。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被对齐到人类目标，控制智能体目标本身反而危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a real goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是智能的核心范式，下一个词预测并非实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本而非预测真实结果。这标志他从方法论批评转向对 LLM 路线的正面否定。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不依赖领域知识、仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，开放式抽象与可靠的持续深度学习是前提，而后者尚未解决。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data and post-training LLMs cannot replace learning from experience.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，不是特例；合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 无法替代从经验中学习，真正的智能需要持续更新权重、避免灾难性遗忘。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating the model itself as the core product and designing with tokens and conversation over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把模型本身当作核心产品，用 token 和对话而非像素来设计。

iansilber.en: Systems thinking is crucial: design primitives that both humans and models can reason about, and prototype rapidly with live models.
iansilber.zh: 系统思维至关重要：设计人类和模型都能推理的设计原语，并用实时模型快速做原型。

iansilber.en: The designer's role is evolving into an editor and curator, not disappearing, and great designers now push technology forward.
iansilber.zh: 设计师的角色正演变为编辑和策展人，而非消失；优秀设计师如今要推动技术前进。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech due to role uncertainty, yet this is the best time to be a designer.
iansilber.zh: 由于角色不确定性，设计师是科技界最不快乐的人，但这却是做设计师最好的时代。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和持有观点上仍不可或缺。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与注意力机制取代了 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的文本训练数据。

jeffdean.en: RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior; models now excel at verifiable-reward math and coding, winning IMO and ICPC gold.
jeffdean.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型行为；模型如今在可验证奖励的数学与编程上表现优异，拿下 IMO 与 ICPC 金牌。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference at 10,000+ tokens/sec is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；每秒 1 万+ token 的超低延迟推理变得至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, with data movement costing ~1000x compute.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：占数据中心功耗 90%，而数据搬运成本约为算力的 1000 倍。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering and taste matter most; startups should target problems where frontier models fail almost completely.
jeffdean.zh: 上下文工程与品味最为关键；初创公司应瞄准前沿模型几乎完全失败的问题，而非部分可行之处。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next revolution: automate whole sectors—food, mining, transport—one industry at a time with specialized robotics, not humanoids.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一场工业革命：用专用机器人而非人形机器人，一个行业一个行业地自动化食品、采矿、运输等整个领域。

traviskalanick.en: The physical world beats the digital one for AI: more variables and stochastic distributions demand empirical understanding, treating atoms like bits.
traviskalanick.zh: 对 AI 而言物理世界比数字世界更有意思：变量更多、分布更随机，需要经验性理解，把原子当比特来处理。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会和媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且有韧性。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective than being pissed off.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命比憋着一股火更干净也更有效。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly without media gatekeepers; stealth mode and direct communication are cultural advantages.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可以绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式和直接沟通都是文化优势。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not raw scale, closes the generalization gap.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正弥合泛化差距的是多样数据，而非单纯的规模。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练则会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts, closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令，其性质更接近强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 能容忍的错误远少于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主需要可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, rather than per-site models.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型；应先做通用策略再微调，而非从零训练逐站点模型。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; startups win via small autonomous teams and AI agents, not capital or headcount.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮：创业公司靠小而高度自主的团队与 AI 智能体取胜，而非资本或人头。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are essential to prevent a unipolar world where one entity controls superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以防止某个实体垄断超级智能的单极世界。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI: agents run on your infrastructure, read memory you own, and compound daily; skill files are your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出“个人 AGI”：智能体跑在你自己的基础设施上、读取你拥有的记忆并每日复利；技能文件就是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; anyone writing clear English can program agents, turning AI into a workforce, not autocomplete.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他主张 Markdown 即代码：能写清楚英文的人就能用智能体编程，把 AI 当劳动力而非自动补全。

garrytan.en: Make something people want; earnest builders beat bankers, and rejection is a resilience test for founders.
garrytan.zh: 始终不变的主线：做人们想要的东西；真诚的建造者胜过银行家，被拒是创始人的韧性考验。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一模型统治一切是错的；未来将出现数百万个专用模型，每个应用场景一个。

linqiao.en: Every company will own its own specialized intelligence; sovereign models are necessary infrastructure.
linqiao.zh: 每家公司都将拥有自己的专用智能；主权模型是必要的基础设施。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, becoming the real moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 后训练将独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，成为超越产品市场契合的真正护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG 到微调再到强化学习的演进，映射了人类学习从事实到品味再到专长的过程。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and reshaping build-vs-buy timing.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本将在三年内下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍，并重塑自建与采购的时机选择。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and AI should reflect the full human experience, including envy and lust.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，AI 应反映完整的人类体验，包括嫉妒与欲望。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more as incoherent slop gets cheap.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，关闭了窥视机器意识的窗口；如今连贯作品成本更高，因为不连贯的垃圾变得廉价。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证与矛盾涌现，而非单一视角；直觉是创作决策的 visceral 指南针。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species of humans and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种，是人类的映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should be replaced with a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, with AI as the primary growth driver and agentic and physical AI as the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，把 AI 作为主要增长引擎，并判断智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI, and Intel's problem is supply, not demand.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年初，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的十倍，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 接棒生成式 AI，并反共识地指出 Intel 的问题是供给而非需求。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with packaging and materials as bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他深化判断：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，先进封装与新材料成为瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; Intel's vertical integration and memory innovation create value, and the trillion-dollar goal arrives four years early.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步强调半导体是一切技术的基础，Intel 的垂直整合与内存创新创造价值，万亿美元目标将提前四年达成。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust through humility and listening, plus culture change and accountability, remain the constant thread across his turnaround playbook.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以谦逊和倾听赢得客户信任，并以文化变革与问责制推动转型。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, prompt short, iterate, and never revert—fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的起点是共情：像智能体一样从零理解代码库，用短提示迭代对话，永不回滚，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays open, so sandbox agents before exposing them publicly.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，公开暴露前必须先做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and run anywhere with any model—the alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: 像 Open Claw 这样的开源智能体让编程民主化，可随处运行、兼容任意模型，是实验室智能体的替代方案。

steinberger.en: Fun, play, and gut-driven small projects are the real drivers of learning and of the next big thing.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣、玩耍和凭直觉做的小项目，才是学习与孕育下一个大想法的真正驱动力。

steinberger.en: The bottleneck is compute and tokens, not model capability; perpetual agents need better economics, and personal brand outlasts any product.
steinberger.zh: 瓶颈在算力与 token，而非模型能力；常驻智能体需要更好的经济模型，而个人品牌比任何单一产品更持久。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not rivals; most enterprises need many models, and open source handles 90% of use cases.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型厂商是资产而非对手；多数企业需要多种模型，开源已能覆盖 90% 的企业用例。

arvindjain.en: Cost, not privacy, drives open-source adoption; inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 推动开源采用的是成本而非隐私；未来 12-18 个月，推理将大规模转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; agents fail without the deep context of tenured employees.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报率是吞吐量与上下文问题；智能体若缺乏资深员工的深层上下文就会失败。

arvindjain.en: Token spend shouldn't be framed as a trade-off with headcount; the fixation on tokens will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 不应把 token 支出与人力成本对立起来；对 token 的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: We're in the very early stages; competition isn't the worry—execution and customer trust are.
arvindjain.zh: 我们仍处于极早期；真正的挑战不是竞争，而是执行与赢得客户信任。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在当年 Transformer 式的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成模型可产出合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Hugging Face shifts from pushing its own libraries to acting as a meta-community builder enabling the broader open source ecosystem.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把 Hugging Face 的角色从推广自家库，重新定位为赋能更广泛社区的元社区构建者。

thomaswolf.en: Open source wins long term on cost and control; humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor, and uncanny valley fears are overblown.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张开源模型凭成本与控制力终将胜出，并质疑人形机器人是否为终极形态，认为恐怖谷担忧被夸大。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, since sandboxes and guardrails fail as models grow capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键层，随着模型能力增强，沙箱与护栏都不够用。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into neuralese, weakening monitoring.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，推理痕迹变成难以理解的神经语，削弱了监控可靠性。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture; openness and slowdown can coexist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张有意放缓 AI 发展是值得的，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获，并强调支持开放与支持放缓并不矛盾。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models, making applied AI the new app layer.
brettaylor.zh: 智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费，应用型 AI 成为新的应用层。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token consumption is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 编程智能体让开发者从作者变为操作者；token 消耗量并非价值衡量标准。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，而非在象牙塔中等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise—tutors, medical advice—and will create more jobs than it displaces.
brettaylor.zh: AI 让专业知识民主化——辅导、医疗建议——创造的工作将多于取代的岗位。

brettaylor.en: The best way to predict the future is to invent it; focus on today's most impactful work, not identity.
brettaylor.zh: 预测未来最好的方式就是创造未来；专注当下最有影响力的事，而非身份标签。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily to know if they work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作对浏览器设计至关重要：网络是混乱的，只有把想法做出来并每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动，允许个人印记和多元声音反而能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他坚持即使像浏览器这样的实用产品，注入情感与个性也是创造难忘、愉悦体验的关键。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation and communication.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他分享 Claude Design 始于一个人的副项目，并主张设计师用 Claude Code 做生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and ship rough.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：随着工程变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型仍缺乏品味，因此应要求大量选项并接受粗糙发布。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle runs in hours.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期以小时计。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering spans GPU kernels to distributed systems, and is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程横跨 GPU 内核到分布式系统，并正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合。

philipkiely.en: The field is shifting from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration as GPUs become more specialized, like ASICs.
philipkiely.zh: 随着 GPU 愈发专用化、趋近 ASIC，该领域正从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: KV cache management and disaggregated prefill/decode are central; continual learning may come via KV cache compaction, not weight updates.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存管理与分离式预填充/解码是核心；持续学习可能通过 KV 缓存压缩而非权重更新实现。

philipkiely.en: Inference demand for engineers will grow 10–100x; specialized, workload-specific systems are key, and human accountability remains essential.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍；针对特定工作负载的专用系统是关键，人类问责仍不可或缺。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，后训练通过强化学习与合成数据实现 Scaling，从而突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; product shifts from specs to prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她提出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值，产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective art; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化立场：后训练仍是主观的艺术，需要多样基准来评估创意写作与情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous; more firms should train their own models to preserve diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她进一步指出前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，基准必须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识与多样性。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined by economic profitability of running agents indefinitely, not by passing tests like the Turing test.
danshipper.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）的定义应是无限期运行智能体能带来经济利润，而非通过图灵测试等基准。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs to the US by making domestic labor cost-effective, contrary to mass unemployment fears.
danshipper.zh: AI 通过使本土劳动力更具成本效益，将工作岗位回流美国，与大规模失业的担忧相反。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have at least one agent to delegate work to; agents need human oversight and care to function well.
danshipper.zh: 每个人将至少有一个智能体来委派工作；智能体需要人类监督和关怀才能良好运作。

danshipper.en: CLIs are over; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work are the future of work surfaces, with one super agent per company.
danshipper.zh: 命令行界面已过时；像 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 这样的图形界面是工作界面的未来，每家公司应有一个超级智能体。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; using it well requires human taste, craft, and curiosity.
danshipper.zh: AI 是你心态的非特定放大器；用好它需要人类的品味、技艺和好奇心。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not stay trapped in cloud products; the best people are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 构建自己的工具，而不是被困在云端产品里；最优秀的人是编辑者，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; to use superintelligent models you must supply a giant prompt with context and a design system.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变得更聪明；要用好超级智能模型，你必须提供带有上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: Chasing trends turns you into AI slop; the edge comes from spending the last 10% on unique features not in existing libraries.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；优势来自把最后 10% 花在现有库中没有的独特功能上。

mengto.en: He writes 0% of the code now—AI writes everything—yet precise communication and curiosity remain the human essentials.
mengto.zh: 他现在 0% 的代码是自己写的——全由 AI 完成——但精确沟通与好奇心仍是人的核心。

mengto.en: High intelligence often holds people back; launch at 80% complete, focus on one painful expensive problem, and fund via high-paying clients rather than venture capital.
mengto.zh: 高智力常常反而拖累人；在完成 80% 时就发布，聚焦一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，靠高付费客户而非风险投资来融资。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融等领域将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吃掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic as initially feared.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，而非最初担心的自我蚕食。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主的 AI，他们希望自己掌握方向盘。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand grows via Jevons paradox, not shrinks.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；需求因杰文斯悖论而增长，而非减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断基础智能已经够用；瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous and asynchronous experiences coexist.
