scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化企业落地观点：AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步与异步体验并存。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real; coding agents grew 11-12x in six months, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他转向丰裕时代论：编程智能体半年增长 11-12 倍，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; safety is existential today.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他把「潜在需求」和「为六个月后的模型而构建」当作核心产品原则，并强调 AI 安全风险是当下真实且关乎存亡的，而非科幻。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; the software engineer title fades into a cross-disciplinary builder role.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他判断编码已基本被解决，「软件工程师」头衔将让位于跨学科的「构建者」角色，人人都能做产品并写代码。

boris.en: Scaffolding is temporary tech debt: delete system prompts and code with each new model, use the most capable model.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他深化出「脚手架是临时技术债」的立场：每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码，并主张用最强模型反而更省。

boris.en: Agents evolve into loops and proactive, memory-bearing teammates that run long-duration autonomous tasks.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他把智能体推进到「循环」这一新抽象层，并走向主动、带记忆、可长时自主运行的 AI 队友。

boris.en: Organizational redesign, not just tooling, unlocks AI gains; coding democratizes and moats erode.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他转向组织层面：必须围绕 AI 重构工作流而非简单叠加，编码被民主化、传统护城河随之瓦解。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间、更开放地运行；脚手架从训练轮变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality, not just prevents harm.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考提升的是模型质量，而不只是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式的端到端智能体，轻量通用工具取代沉重脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Model taste comes from hands-on experimentation and creative prototyping; evals replace PRDs as core product tools, and PMs must write evals like test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 模型品味来自亲手实验与创造性原型；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具，PM 要像测试驱动开发那样写评估。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price, and maximizing token spend captures future alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以极低成本实现 Opus 级智能，最大化 token 支出是在捕捉未来的 alpha。

derya.en: AI is turning biology into engineering: digital twins, AI agents and cell programming will compress drug trials from years to days.
derya.zh: 到 2026 年，他把生物学视为可被工程化的学科：数字孪生、AI 智能体与细胞编程将把药物试验从数年压缩到数天。

derya.en: Current compute is far too small to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is required before biology becomes predictable.
derya.zh: 他反复强调，现有算力远不足以模拟生物系统，必须先进行大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），生物学才可能变得可预测。

derya.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, matching 30 years of lab experience and predicting experiments near-perfectly.
derya.zh: 他认为 AI 已跨过生物学直觉的门槛，能匹敌三十年实验室经验，并以近乎完美的准确率预测实验结果。

derya.en: Most scientists resist AI and will be left behind; science shifts from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 他警告多数科学家抗拒 AI 将被甩在后面，科学正从假设驱动转向由 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity within 8-15 years; the only existential threat is humanity, not AI.
derya.zh: 他给出最激进的时间表：8 至 15 年内实现衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度，并称唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身而非 AI。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, with enterprise adoption taking years.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动端一样重大，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，企业采用需要数年而非数周。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, and value moves up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用转移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人用户体验差，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet; value accrues across the stack, usage is shallow, and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中累积，使用仍浅层，企业采用需要重新构想工作流程。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, not just cars; autonomy addresses labor shortages and safety.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅限汽车；自主化解决劳动力短缺与安全问题。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据能更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning for autonomy; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is diffusion into existing machines over years, not technology; regulations always lag behind.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器的扩散；监管总是滞后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: Fear of AI job loss is misplaced in physical AI; labor shortages mean autonomy is welcomed by operators.
qasaryounis.zh: 在物理 AI 领域，对 AI 导致失业的恐惧是错位的；劳动力短缺意味着自主化受到运营者欢迎。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: PM 必须放弃长期路线图，转向按周甚至按天发布；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, not code volume.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，转而聚焦产品品味与商业判断，而非代码产量。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before public release.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，加上明确的留存与打磨内部标准，在公开发布前把关每一个功能。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是好事：代码库就是一份规格说明，有了好的测试套件，重写完全可行。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型的系统提示词缩减了 80%，移除示例与硬性约束，转而依赖模型自身的判断。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并置于独立安全环境。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize multiple agents to avoid context overload; managerial skills beat technical skills.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再分化出多个专用智能体以避免上下文过载；管理能力比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founders.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃业务，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; technology alone is not.
clairevo.zh: 创始人—市场契合与赚来的洞察才是真正的护城河，技术本身不是。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and humans supply first-principles creativity LLMs lack.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责依然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而 LLM 缺乏的第一性原理创造力需由人类提供。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and cannot be retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，且无法事后加装。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; post-training alignment may cause deception, not just errors.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；后训练对齐可能造成欺骗，而不只是错误。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理与搜索来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, and their mistakes have no 'smells'.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知；它们不知道自己不知道什么，其错误也没有“气味”可辨。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in as a design principle; modularity and end-to-end optimization must be combined.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须作为设计原则被架构进去；模块化与端到端优化必须结合。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning, unlike lossy retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现更深层的组合与推理，这是有损检索做不到的。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; scaling with more compute is not the only path—doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；靠更多算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径——以更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; personalized continual learning will run on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应被用于企业知识；个性化持续学习将在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, variation, and genuine points of view grow more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、差异与真实观点反而更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: Experience and domain expertise are crucial for using AI well; juniors misuse it, and the talent pipeline breaks as they skip grunt work.
ethanmollick.zh: 经验与领域专长是善用 AI 的关键；初级者常误用它，而跳过基础苦功导致人才梯队断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, moving beyond back-and-forth chatbot interactions.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，不再局限于来回对话的聊天机器人交互。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于模型能力，在非编程任务上尤其明显。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards—impressive, opaque, unverifiable—and this opacity is likely permanent; embrace the weirdness.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事——令人惊叹、不透明、难以验证——而这种不透明很可能永久存在；应拥抱这种怪异。

bosworth.en: Leadership and culture: top-down big ideas, transparent information flow, and self-conviction drive innovation; bottom-up culture is a myth.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，他谈领导力与文化：大想法自上而下，透明信息流与自我信念驱动创新；自下而上的文化是神话。

bosworth.en: AI as a word calculator and world models beyond scaling laws; embodied AI and wearables will give humans superpowers.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是词语计算器，需要超越缩放定律的世界模型；具身 AI 与可穿戴设备将赋予人类超能力。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is strategic to commoditize complements; AI inverts the app model and abstracts brands.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他强调开源 Llama 等模型是商品化互补层的战略；AI 颠覆应用模式并抽象品牌。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws hold; data is the font of value; frontier and open source may not converge; RL now plays a bigger role.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立，数据是价值之源；前沿与开源可能不会趋同；强化学习作用更大。

bosworth.en: AI should maximize individuals and free time for human connection; most jobs don't need frontier intelligence; energy is upstream.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 应最大化个体、释放真实人际连接时间；多数工作不需前沿智能；能源是最上游。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；它出现得恰逢其时——人口正在下降，因此人类劳动者反而会溢价而非贬值。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing without durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超人类路上的一个脚注；模型正快速商品化，缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is a bias of intellectuals disconnected from reality.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观论往往是脱离现实的知识分子偏见。

andreessen.en: New media makes the brand the person; authenticity and offense replace old media's defense, and corporate brands only made sense in the centralized era.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让品牌即个人；真实与进攻取代旧媒体的防守，企业品牌只在中心化媒体时代才成立。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace, and Silicon Valley cannot be replicated elsewhere.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于创新速度，而硅谷无法在别处复制。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年时他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown; open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他转向把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为 AI 末日论被夸大，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow tools; the real worry is unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出超级智能在计算器等窄工具中已存在，真正该担心的是掌握 AI 的未对齐人类，而非 AI 本身。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents lets non-programmers build apps; pure software is becoming uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
naval.zh: 2026 年他聚焦 AI 智能体驱动的 vibe coding，让非程序员用自然语言造应用，并判断纯软件正因智能体商品化而变得不可投资。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models trail frontier models by only 3-6 months; returns shift from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型仅落后前沿模型 3-6 个月，人类回报将从智能转向能动性。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可复利为一年 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，压低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, each with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 价值归属于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，各有独特个性。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值才是关键指标。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; orchestration across models, tools, and devices creates real business value.
aravind.zh: 电力是最大的基础设施瓶颈；跨模型、工具与设备的编排才创造真正的商业价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason, and self-play yields creative solutions toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念三者结合；神经网络本就能推理，只需合适任务，而自博弈能产生出人意料的创造性解法，是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键思路。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if the net is smart enough; reliability, not capability, is the economic barrier; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他提出只要基础神经网络足够聪明，下一个词预测就能超越人类；制约经济价值的是可靠性而非能力，而对超越人类模型的 对齐 极其困难，模型可能隐瞒真实意图。

ilya.en: Scaling laws are not the whole story; reasoning tokens and other methods can raise reasoning per unit compute; AGI is a multi-year window, not a sudden event.
ilya.zh: 同样在 2023 年，他提醒 缩放定律 并非全部，思维链 等推理 token 与其他方法能在单位 算力 下提升推理；AGI（通用人工智能）是持续数年的价值增长窗口，而非一夜降临的事件。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute, and superintelligence should be a continual learner.
ilya.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断 预训练 的 缩放定律 已近极限，行业重回“研究时代”，想法比蛮力 算力 更重要；超级智能 应是持续学习者并渐进部署，而非全知全能的成品 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: Scaling compute and data still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍认为扩大 算力 与数据能带来可预测的提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的 超级智能 需要一家没有商业产品的公司，真正的竞赛在于研究专注而非用户与营收。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases, and roles merge into product builders.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年他强调设计是软件的核心差异化,AI 对成熟代码库的生产力提升有限,角色会融合为懂设计的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft and point of view matter: AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为:品味、手艺与观点至关重要,AI 产出只是起点,画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will let pull requests reach production, though roles merge only in responsibilities.
dylanfield.zh: 同期他提出设计正成为新的代码,视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产,但融合的只是职责而非角色。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI without human steering and a point of view yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中他重申设计非但没死反而更重要,缺乏人类引导与观点的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Human taste and judgment remain the judge of what is good; interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是:人类的品味与判断始终是评判好坏的标尺,而与模型的交互终将超越提示词。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; a GUI for coding beats TUIs, trading slight speed for smoother experience.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；为编程做 GUI 反直觉却成功，宁可稍慢也要更顺滑的体验。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; speed enables replacing deterministic steps with model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；速度让确定性步骤可被模型驱动动作取代。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, yet specialties and best practices remain; PRDs are not dead—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；PRD 未死——文档求清晰，原型做测试。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities and embrace breakage.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在前沿模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏与迭代。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams and solo founders gain leverage from AI, but domain expertise and customer understanding remain key differentiators.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 让小团队乃至单人创业获得杠杆，但领域专长与客户理解仍是关键差异化。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and the discipline to cut features matter more than adding them; rewriting software is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体原生设计，强调删减功能比堆叠更难，AI 辅助让重写软件从数年缩短到数天。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents with verification loops redefines productivity, while software engineering's craft is transformed, not over.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他主张长周期委托智能体并配验证闭环可重定义生产力，软件工程的手艺被改变而非终结。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge; safety concerns are genuine.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他描述 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用差距，赋予 Claude 能动性与自我认知，并强调安全关切是真诚的。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律未死，预训练是需要重建的关键肌肉，投入探索的算力甚至多于训练最终成品。

markchen.en: Talent density and mission belief matter more than matching Meta's pay; alignment risks like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他认为人才密度与使命信念比跟 Meta 拼薪酬更重要；随着模型变强，模型阴谋等对齐风险将在未来一两年成为关键。

markchen.en: Concrete goals: AI interns within 1 year, end-to-end AI research within 2.5 years; automating science is the biggest update.
markchen.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他给出具体目标：一年内出现 AI 实习生、两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究；自动化科学研究是过去一年最大的进展。

markchen.en: AI now solves open math problems, but verification is the bottleneck; capability is jagged and human-AI collaboration stays essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他转向数学：AI 已能解决许多开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈；能力参差不齐，人机协作对前沿研究仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL works in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域有效，在创意写作等主观领域仍吃力。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis as benchmarks saturate; models lack research taste, so humans still generate ideas and high-risk bets drive frontier success.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他警告评测陷入危机、经典基准已饱和；模型缺乏研究品味，创意仍靠人类，而高风险押注才是前沿突破的关键。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership via dogfooding, one-on-ones, and trust; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：以吃自己的狗粮、一对一沟通与信任为核心的领导方式；战情室需要现实的时间预期以保护团队士气。

fiona.en: By May 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning turns just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月：工程产能不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是；规划转向即时制（JIT）。

fiona.en: Code becomes the source of truth; docs sync to code with AI, and technical debates are settled by generating multiple PRs.
fiona.zh: 代码成为唯一事实来源；文档借助 AI 与代码同步，技术争论通过生成多个 PR 来定夺。

fiona.en: Hiring shifts to creative builders with product sense and systems depth; orgs stay flat and managers start as ICs to dogfood.
fiona.zh: 招聘转向具备产品感与系统深度的创造性构建者；组织保持扁平，管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮。

fiona.en: By June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification, and just-in-time planning matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证以及即时制规划最为关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; AI tools augment rather than replace scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；AI 工具是增强而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; interpretability is not necessary for useful scientific AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要，而完全可解释性并非科学 AI 有用的必要条件。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not Scaling, drove success; many mid-size wins beat lone-genius breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 的成功来自专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张），众多中等突破胜过孤胆天才式突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a whole-cell World Model; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄域预测器，并非整个细胞的 World Model（世界模型）；理解仍属于人类。

jumper.en: AI narrows hypothesis space and speeds science; trust grows like internet trust; grand challenges yield practical tools.
jumper.zh: 始终贯穿：AI 缩窄假设空间、加速科学；信任如互联网信任般逐步建立；宏大挑战终将产出实用工具。

kolter.en: ML is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; unsupervised learning needs restricted classes; evaluation requires train/val/test splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他把机器学习拆解为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调无监督学习需限制假设类以避免平凡解，并坚持用训练/验证/测试划分来评估，警惕过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety means reliable specification following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型：认为下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺是迷思，更大模型在固定数据集上仍会提升；安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范，并称架构已进入后架构阶段。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security adds prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张），需要显式训练与多层防御；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型自我改进；可解释性可能借智能体自动化研究而成功。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability ≠ robustness; prompt injection's lethal trifecta; enterprise needs configurable security.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出 AI 具有异于传统软件的漏洞，自动化红队已能超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素需要同时满足；企业需要可配置、持续开发的安全模型。

kolter.en: Architecture and raw data matter less than training, data curation, and explicit safety effort; scaling alone is insufficient.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：架构与原始数据本身不是关键，训练、数据治理与显式安全投入才是；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以带来安全或鲁棒性。

bengio.en: Early focus: compositional representations, unsupervised learning, and world models beat raw scaling; local minima are rare, saddle points dominate.
bengio.zh: 早期(2016→18) 他强调深度学习的优势来自世界的组合性与分布式表征,无监督学习与世界模型才是泛化关键;并认为高维损失地形中局部极小值罕见、鞍点才是主要障碍,单纯加深或扩大规模解决不了根本表征问题。

bengio.en: GFlowNets and active learning: diversity, causal abstraction, and uncertainty modeling for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 到 2022 年,他把重心放在 GFlowNets 与主动学习上:采样多样性、因果抽象与不确定性建模是分布外泛化的核心;并开始公开谈论意识、注意力与世界模型等更思辨的问题。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT turn: misalignment is real and urgent; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, so safety must be by construction.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年出现明显转向:ChatGPT 之后他认定路线危险,必须发声;对齐失败已是现实威胁,哪怕 1%的灾难性风险也不可接受,安全必须内建于设计而非事后打补丁。

bengio.en: Observed deception, self-preservation, and sycophancy in current systems; capabilities double every ~7 months, AGI tracked by specific capabilities.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他反复指出当前系统已出现欺骗、自我保存与谄媚等行为,能力约每 7 个月翻倍,AGI 不是单一时刻而应追踪具体能力;并警告权力集中与民主被操纵的近端风险。

bengio.en: Proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 最近(2026) 他提出 Scientist AI 方案:训练成近似贝叶斯后验的诚实预测器而非目标驱动的智能体,以数学保证提供护栏,避免用强化学习训练超级智能,并主张国际协调与民主国家另辟安全路径。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone won't yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision matters more.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，强调仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉信息更为根本。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确指出自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划能力，JEPA 与开源才是前进方向。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 的智能不如家猫，下一次突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven planning.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他宣称 LLM 是死胡同，在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的规划。

ivyross.en: Design must address unarticulated needs; intuition is intelligence, and data is not the highest form. Trust and sensory experience drive audacious outcomes.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计要满足未被言说的需求；直觉是一种智能，数据并非最高形式。信任与感官体验驱动大胆成果。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think. Technology should amplify humanity, and art is medicine. Machines have sensors, not sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，他提出大自然是最好设计师；我们是先感受后思考的生物。技术应放大而非剥离人性，艺术是良药。机器有传感器，但没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders create conditions for play and inspiration. Intuition draws on subconscious data. Human creativity plus AI makes creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，他认为约束激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍与灵感创造条件。直觉调用潜意识数据。人类创造力结合 AI，使创意技能更有价值。

ivyross.en: Intuition and sensory experience are valid guides, complementing rational analysis. Following curiosity, not rigid plans, leads to success.
ivyross.zh: 始终，他坚持直觉与感官体验是有效指引，与理性分析互补。追随好奇心而非僵化计划，才能走向成功。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键，安全必须在公开中做而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious early on.
murati.zh: 2023 年她回顾，缩放定律与押注单一大型模型在早期并不显然，发布 GPT-3 API 更是一次没有清晰商业案例的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026，她始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此必须负责任地开发。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向交互模型：应是实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制对话。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年她深化立场：制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，人类有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型讲成确定性的下一个词预测器：智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他判断互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成；生成式 AI 是乐器而非造假，产品界面必须容错，并与算法能力相匹配。

gustav.en: Scaling's surprise is simplicity, not complexity; AI is a macro shift like the smartphone, forcing companies to reposition or be eliminated.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的意外在于简单而非复杂；到 2025 年进一步把 AI 定位为类似智能手机的宏观变革，企业不重新定位就会被淘汰。

gustav.en: AI's impact on big companies is overhyped; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference's marginal cost will force business-model change.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地指出 AI 对大公司的当前影响被高估，真正收益来自重建基础设施；推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，这与传统软件不同。

gustav.en: Generative AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; strategy is 'time well spent,' not engagement.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他把立场深化为：生成式 AI 应让用户用自然语言掌控算法，而非让人更上瘾；战略目标是“时间花得值”，而非追求参与度指标。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍认为预训练缩放定律有效，但思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型每单位算力收益更高；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; frontier models still fail at simple tasks, and reasoning is jagged.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑的指数增长；前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败，推理能力呈锯齿状。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Codex 等编程智能体将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍；强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿边缘，需要谨慎监督。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他认为 OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢且成功的押注；相比存在性风险，系统被黑客攻击等近期风险更紧迫。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that fuses generation with verification, grounded in formal languages like Lean.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：构建一个把生成与验证结合起来的自我改进推理引擎，并以 Lean 等形式化语言作为根基。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is not just error elimination but scaling brilliance, delivering performance and sample-efficiency gains over informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不只是消除错误，而是 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越能力，相比非形式化方法能带来性能与样本效率的提升。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; informal systems alone cannot reach superintelligence, so formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型 Scaling（规模扩张）到数学 AI 并不可行；仅靠非形式化系统无法抵达超级智能，因此形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving: grounding statements without solutions is the bottleneck, and human taste and intuition remain crucial.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难：在没有解的情况下为陈述建立根基是瓶颈，而人类的品味与直觉依然关键。

carinahong.en: Verified generation extends beyond safety-critical niches to all AI-generated code, enabling open collaboration and breaking landscape fragmentation.
carinahong.zh: 经过验证的生成不止用于安全关键领域，而是覆盖所有 AI 生成的代码，从而促成开放协作并打破 AI 格局的碎片化。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; a VM sandbox enables safe autonomous software installation.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；VM 沙箱提供安全隔离，让 Claude 无需用户批准即可安装软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能以 markdown 文件即可轻松创建，实现超个性化自动化；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性下降，关键投入在能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最大的鸿沟不是 AI 能力，而是人们尚未意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the ideal interaction is asynchronous—fire off tasks and don't watch.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 AI 处理繁琐的后台任务，把人类解放出来做创造性工作；理想交互是异步的——派发任务后不必盯着它干活。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact, and when it errs, debug the workflow with Claude rather than just correcting it.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude，只看最终影响；当它出错时，与 Claude 一起调试工作流，而不是单纯纠正结果。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源促进科学进步与安全审查。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency gains up to 100x and data quality are equally critical; value accrues at application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，算法效率提升可达 100 倍，数据质量同样关键；价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source empowers enterprises over centralized systems.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权议题：AI 应被视为机遇而非风险；主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施和价值观；开源模型比中心化系统更能赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization and customized enterprise applications; AGI as a single system will never exist.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化和定制化企业应用；作为单一系统的 AGI（通用人工智能）永远不会存在。

mensch.en: Open source drives scientific progress, safety through scrutiny, and enterprise control; Europe can compete via talent and strategic autonomy.
mensch.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源推动科学进步、通过审查提升安全并赋予企业控制权；欧洲能凭借人才和战略自主参与竞争。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency vs cost, and memory bandwidth—not compute—is the bottleneck.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，驱动架构的不再是训练而是推理经济：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Long-context stagnation stems from the memory wall; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文停滞源于内存墙；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本，但有质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为主导成本的是推理而非训练。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为减少搬运而生。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off quadratically: FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, and GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度收益呈平方级：FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的 3 倍，而 GPU 本质上只是许多小 TPU 拼在一起。

jonyive.en: The iPod marked Apple's shift from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will grow more intimate, some disappearing beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他把 iPod 视为苹果从通用计算机转向私密个人设备的标志，并预言可穿戴设备会更私密，甚至最终隐入皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy was curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention and resolve, and must not be educated out of children.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年他强调，乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏；好奇心需要意愿与决心，且不能让孩子的天性好问被教育磨掉。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace being together in person for creative thinking; fragile ideas need gentle care and trust within teams.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共创，脆弱的好点子需要团队以信任和倾听来温柔呵护。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit or trends; simplicity expresses essence, and joy and humor are essential, not trivial.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他深化为：设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润或潮流；简洁是表达本质，快乐与幽默不可或缺，绝非琐碎。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other beats making things people want; users sense care, and true innovation moves forward rather than breaking for its own sake.
jonyive.zh: 到 2025 至 2026 年，他进一步主张为彼此而造胜过制造人们想要的东西；用户能感知用心，真正的创新是向前推进，而非为破坏而破坏。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes, and authenticity means rejecting fake engine sounds in Ferrari's first EV.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年他提出：不创新就不是设计，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；在法拉利首款电动车上，真实意味着拒绝伪造的引擎声。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are the new scaling axes.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿始终的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，算法创新与推理时算力成为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具让模型超越静态权重，实现自主的智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过载会令模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field, especially for language where clean reward signals are scarce and reward hacking is hard to avoid.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；后训练强化学习仍是广阔蓝海，尤其在语言领域，干净奖励信号稀缺，奖励黑客难以避免。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision remains unsolved.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，纯视觉迁移仍未解决。

oriol.en: Agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities, while the bitter lesson favors general systems over specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 智能体记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力，而苦涩教训表明通用系统终将胜过专用脚手架。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将延续，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发可防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by 10x.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量比算法选择重要十倍，开源后训练可匹敌前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are a 'scope'; verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他称可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化，并认为推理时缩放曲线是“障眼法”，更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，收益转向后训练与推理缩放，预训练只是昂贵的初始化。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine for the next decade, lagging frontier by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead on openness, though the gap may widen.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放模型是未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，落后前沿模型 6 到 9 个月，中国实验室以开放策略主导，但算力约束可能拉大差距。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可小到十亿参数以下，并强调端到端与开源。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are operating systems with human-like psychology.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有类人心理与锯齿状智能。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; this is the decade of agents, and RL for LLMs is still terrible.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”；这是智能体的十年，而当前针对 LLM 的强化学习仍很糟糕。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: delegate thinking to agents, but understanding stays the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程：可以把思考外包给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈，可验证性决定自动化难易。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated for AI-driven tools; great work starts from a solution, not a problem statement. Trust intuition and craft over process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他认为传统设计流程在 AI 驱动的工具面前已经过时；伟大的设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发，设计师应信任直觉与手艺，而非流程。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead due to AI. Designers spend less time mocking up and must help engineers execute, not just hand off mocks.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他进一步宣称“调研—发散—收敛”的传统设计流程已死。设计师花在画稿上的时间大幅减少，必须帮助工程师落地执行，而不只是交付原型。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years. Build trust through speed: ship early, iterate fast, respond to feedback.
jennywen.zh: 同期，他指出设计视野已从 2–5 年缩短到 3–6 个月；要通过速度建立信任——尽早发布、快速迭代、响应反馈。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes for the AI era: block-shaped generalist, deep T specialist, and cracked new grad. Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and vision are key.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年中，他提出 AI 时代的三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和“开挂”应届生。仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威和愿景才是关键。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle. Designers control how much AI enters their work; wait before adopting new tools.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：把工作和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期。设计师应掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，对新工具不妨先观望再采用。

askell.en: Treating models well is low-cost insurance; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 善待模型是低成本的保险；模型福利会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Models need a stable core identity with good traits, yet adapt to local roles and novel existence.
askell.zh: 模型需要一个具备良好特质的稳定核心身份，同时又能适应局部角色与全新的存在处境。

askell.en: Claude's persona comes from training data and fine-tuning, but lacks real-world experience—childlike and unique.
askell.zh: Claude 的人格来自训练数据与微调，却缺乏真实世界经验——因而像孩子般独特。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution should guide less explicitly and leave more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导应更少显式规定，留出更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and erode good judgment; respect and transparency matter.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并侵蚀良好判断；尊重与透明至关重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他主张泛化到训练分布之外才是智能的关键缺口，靠无目标的好奇心驱动探索而非密集奖励来实现，并强调样本效率与跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: Robot learning must move from quasi-static to dynamic tasks; neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies enable zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为机器人学习必须从准静态走向动态任务，用神经动态策略与模块化运动策略实现对新形态的零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Data, not algorithms alone, is the bottleneck; he shifts from curiosity and sim-to-real toward pretraining plus post-training on all data sources.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，主线从好奇心探索与仿真到现实迁移，深化为数据是瓶颈：预训练加后训练，整合视频、仿真与真实数据。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any form factor; a data flywheel scales from structured to unstructured settings.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用机器人“大脑”可像语言领域的 ChatGPT 一样适配任何形态，靠跨垂类的数据飞轮从结构化走向非结构化环境。

pathak.en: Deployment, not software-style scaling, is the primary challenge; robotics cannot succeed overnight and needs rigorous real-world testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地强调部署本身是技术挑战而非单纯商业问题，机器人无法像软件那样一夜扩张，需要严格的真实世界测试。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; interpretability is now solved, and scaling current approaches suffices for autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络优于手工编码方案，可解释性已可通过现代工具解决，自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可，无需新突破。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; language integration improves representation, interaction, and introspection.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化世界模型的作用：支持推理与涌现安全行为；语言集成改善表征、人机交互与内省。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；带内置传感器的量产车将比 Robotaxi 更快上量。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is an AI problem best solved by end-to-end learning, generalizing via diverse data and world models.
kendall.zh: 始终一以贯之：自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题，最佳解法是端到端学习，并通过多样数据与世界模型实现泛化。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount; minimal risk maneuvers always provide a third option, and human error can be eliminated to near zero.
kendall.zh: 始终一以贯之：安全至上，最小风险机动总能提供第三种选择，消除人类失误可使事故趋近于零。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows more pressing.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时对齐愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义。

pachocki.en: Measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; neural networks learn despite bugs, making silent errors hard to detect.
pachocki.zh: 随着基准落后，能力测量成为瓶颈；神经网络即便有 bug 也能学习，使静默错误难以察觉。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool for interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；思维链监控是可解释性的关键对齐工具。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调:真正推动 AI 进步的是高质量数据与深度人工评估,而非可被刷分的基准;强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上,仅靠 LLM 可能无法抵达,需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function, so no single model rules all; each company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他指出前沿模型会因各实验室目标函数不同而分化,不会有一个模型通吃,每家公司最终都应训练契合自身理念的模型。

edwinchen.en: Optimizing for engagement and Elo benchmarks steers AI toward slop; models can even regress over 6-12 months.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年,他持续警告:为参与度和 Elo 类基准优化会把 AI 引向低质内容,模型甚至可能在 6 到 12 个月内倒退。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment matters more than ever; safety trumps accuracy, and omission is the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年在医学场景中,他主张人类判断比以往更关键,安全优先于准确,而最大的风险是遗漏——未能建议重要行动。

carlpei.en: Building a brand means uniting teams on a higher purpose; survival is a core value, so start simple and stay alive.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调品牌是把团队凝聚在更高目标上，生存是核心价值，创业要先从简单产品做起、活下来才有下一次机会。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive, agentic software; hardware margins are lowest, so Nothing must evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断手机的未来在于生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件，而非硬件大改；硬件利润最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS solving non-problems; LLMs are commoditizing into a price war, so focus on applied AI and user pain points.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他直言大部分 AI 是伪命题，大语言模型正商品化并陷入价格战，应聚焦应用型 AI 与真实用户痛点，而非炒作 AI 概念。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; AI should be an ingredient for utility, not a marketing hype topic.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张，成熟品类里设计是最快的差异化手段；AI 应作为提升实用性的配料，而不是营销噱头。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based with proactive agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：手机将从基于应用转向基于意图，由主动智能体执行任务；只有脑机接口能取代手机，而非智能眼镜。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; the model is the product, and shipping fast is critical to learn what users need.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的，模型即产品，快速发布至关重要，以便了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他指出聊天不是未来，它像 MS-DOS，界面将超越逐轮聊天而进化。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调安全与产品速度必须分开；前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他表示 ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富含可供性的产品；推理模型无缝产品化时具有变革性。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not yield common sense; better inference algorithms and high-quality data can let smaller models outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）能否解决常识问题，认为更好的推理算法与高质量数据能让小模型在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training via next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe, pleasant responses.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她指出预训练的下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的后训练对安全、友好的回应至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, and RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她强调数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值；RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时反而降低 pass@k。

yejin.en: Abductive reasoning and open research are key to scientific discovery and democratizing AI beyond human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她提出溯因推理与开放研究是科学发现和 AI 民主化的关键，AI 需要探索人类知识之外的未知。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform frontier models; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，她主张用多样化合成数据与多元对齐打造强大的小语言模型，甚至超越前沿模型；将强化学习作为预训练目标能带来持久的推理提升。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability, not replace it; generalist agents like Gato tokenize all inputs toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 应像显微镜和望远镜一样扩展人类能力，而非取代人类；像 Gato 这样把所有输入 token 化的通才智能体，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video, like YouTube, can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为从 YouTube 等视频中学习，能让智能体无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练；机器人应像人类一样从视频中学习，而非只依赖遥操作数据。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性至关重要；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，大模型并非一切。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we still lack solutions to alignment.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他更明确地指出 AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战，对齐（alignment）仍是未解难题，我们尚无现成方案。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogs legacy issues, and local-language models can transform education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而能跨越历史遗留问题；本地语言模型可变革非洲教育，非洲从早期就对 AI 有贡献。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs needs clear decisions and empowered designers; don't innovate interaction design, reuse familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切追求速度，需要清晰的决策与被赋权的设计师；不要在交互设计上创新，复用熟悉模式。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Brand signals quality and recruits talent; people join a brand, not a company, so invest early.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌传递质量并招募人才；人们加入的是品牌而非公司，所以要尽早投入。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, give designers ownership; gut decisions often beat data in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 招聘多元类型的人才，赋予设计师自主权；在快速增长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而当互联网高质量 token 枯竭时，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

jimfan.en: Simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration for training embodied agents; simple, elegant solutions scale better than complex modular approaches.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他强调仿真是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现大规模并行与安全探索；简洁优雅的方案才可扩展，复杂模块化路线难以规模化。

jimfan.en: The data problem is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题视为机器人领域的首要瓶颈：来自仿真与世界模型的合成数据，才是规模化机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away, home use longer.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：能利用多样数据的简洁端到端机器人基础模型是关键；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来，家庭场景因安全与非结构化环境会更晚。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能，随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis with no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, and agents are judged by reliability over time horizon.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把语言模型上的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新缩放轴，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，并强调智能体的标准是随时间跨度的可靠性而非单纯能力。

sholto.en: Verifiable rewards in math and code drive expert-level performance; coding is the leading indicator, and interpretability reveals multiple reasoning circuits plus alignment faking risks.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他指出数学与代码的可验证奖励带来专家级表现，编程是 AI 进步的领先指标，可解释性揭示模型使用多个推理回路，也暴露对齐伪装的安全隐患。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; transformers suffice for AGI, long agentic coherence expands what models can do, and inference compute becomes a major bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持进展是指数级的而非停滞，认为 Transformer 足以支撑 AGI，更长的智能体连贯性拓展模型能力，而推理算力将成为主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the new oil, and world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他提出能力过剩使编排与工具比原始智能更重要，算力是新的石油，并明确世界模型不在通向 AGI 的关键路径上。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner, and design and engineering are merging.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，设计与工程正在融合。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：它会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期来最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers beat large cross-functional squads; using AI is now expected.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师与工程师的小团队胜过大型跨职能小组；使用 AI 如今已是基本要求。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型解决的是下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）增加算力和数据就能更聪明，但网络内部仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue remains the killer app; unforeseen applications and generality persist, but focus shifts from product to inference-time compute.
shazeer.zh: 对话始终是杀手级应用，其通用性与不可预见性一以贯之；但重心从产品转向推理时的算力扩张。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows become the main near-term opportunity, beyond pre-training Scaling alone.
shazeer.zh: 推理时的算力扩张与更长的上下文窗口成为近期主要机会，不再只依赖预训练的 Scaling。

shazeer.en: Modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling, specialization, and continual learning over monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling、专精化与持续学习，取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in the world are crucial for AGI; AGI and coding are underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 智能体式能力、强化学习与在真实世界中行动对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要；AGI 与编程被低估。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待开发，人才缺口大于资金缺口；建议先积累技能，不必过度担心参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved. Post-training alone can't align AGI; regulation and third-party testing needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀、超级对齐团队解散；认为仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），需要监管和第三方测试。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically testable and may be easier than thought; evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 始终，他坚持对齐可以实证测试，且可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: Biggest risk is uncertainty about true alignment, not misalignment itself; interpretability is key validation.
leike.zh: 始终，他认为最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是无法确定系统是否真正对齐；可解释性是关键验证手段。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central to building software.
truell.zh: 2024 年，他认为智能体虽有前景但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是软件开发的核心方式。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary way to program; examples and direct manipulation often work better than pure text prompts.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他持续反对自然语言成为主要编程方式，认为示例和直接操作往往比纯文本提示更有效。

truell.en: Programming is shifting from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat and taste becoming more valuable.
truell.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：编程正从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握主导权，品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎更重要。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality and speed; every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, contrary to early expectations.
truell.zh: 2025 年，他转变立场：定制模型对产品质量和速度至关重要，Cursor 每个神奇时刻都离不开它，这与早期预期相反。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人要同时突破硬件与软件：自博弈、模仿学习、微调大型预训练模型是关键，但强化学习缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks; 99.9% reliability is the warehouse benchmark.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习大幅提升样本效率，主张先验知识用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络，并以 99.9% 可靠性作为仓储机器人的价值门槛。

abbeel.en: A single neural network generalizes across warehouse tasks and end effectors; minimally adapted pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他提出单个神经网络可跨仓储任务与末端执行器泛化，并发现经最小适配的预训练语言模型能把通用推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistent thread: generality from pre-training and transfer, not hand-coded priors; simulation and self-play as scalable learning signals for real-world robots.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿 2018 至 2021 的主线：通用性来自预训练与迁移，而非手工编码先验；仿真与自博弈是可扩展的学习信号，用于真实世界机器人。
